title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
title_zh: 宋世界：迈向交互式姿态可控的超声世界模型

paragraphs.en: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments: physical phantoms and acoustic simulators exhibit a substantial domain gap from clinical images, and trial-and-error exploration on patients is unsafe. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an electromagnetic (EM) sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation. Project page is available under https://iclr2027anonymous.github.io/SonoWorld/ .

paragraphs.en: Ultrasound is among the most widely used diagnostic imaging modalities, valued for its real-time imaging, absence of ionizing radiation, portability, and low cost ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) . Unlike many imaging modalities, however, ultrasound acquisition is inherently interactive: the observed image depends on the six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) pose of a hand-held probe, which the operator continuously adjusts to navigate anatomy and acquire diagnostically standard views. Consequently, image quality and diagnostic yield depend heavily on operator expertise, contributing to substantial inter-operator variability and a persistent shortage of trained sonographers ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) . Robotic ultrasound offers a promising path toward standardized image acquisition, reduced operator workload, and broader access to expert-level scanning, particularly in remote and resource-limited settings ( Du et al., 2024 ) . Realizing this potential requires robotic scanning policies that map observed ultrasound images to probe motions, whose development and evaluation in turn require realistic interactive environments in which the visual consequences of probe actions can be observed.
paragraphs.zh: 超声是最广泛使用的诊断成像模式之一，因其实时成像、无电离辐射、便携性和低成本而备受青睐（Wang 等，2020；Jiang 等，2023）。 然而，与许多其他成像模式不同，超声采集本质上具有交互性：所观察到的图像取决于手持探头六个自由度（6-DoF）的姿态，而操作者需要持续调整这一姿态以定位解剖结构并获取符合诊断标准的图像。 因此，图像质量和诊断效果在很大程度上依赖于操作者的专业技能，这导致了操作者之间的显著差异，并持续造成合格超声检查师的短缺（Jiang 等，2023）。 机器人超声技术为实现标准化的图像采集、减轻操作者负担以及更广泛地普及专家级扫描能力提供了有前景的路径，尤其是在偏远和资源有限的地区（Du 等，2024）。 要实现这一潜力，需要开发能够将观察到的超声图像映射到探头运动的机器人扫描策略，而这类策略的开发与评估又依赖于能够观察到探头操作所带来视觉效果的逼真交互环境。

paragraphs.en: Existing environments for robotic ultrasound expose a fundamental trade-off between controllability, realism, and safety. Physical phantoms and physics-based simulators permit controlled exploration over probe poses, but their synthetic anatomy and image formation leave a substantial domain gap from clinical ultrasound ( Shams et al., 2008 ; Bürger et al., 2013 ; Gao et al., 2009 ) . Re-slicing reconstructed 3D ultrasound volumes provides more realistic observations, but requires subject-specific tracked acquisitions and cannot faithfully reproduce view-dependent appearance changes under arbitrary probe orientations ( Lasso et al., 2014 ) . Scanning real patients provides observations from the true clinical distribution, yet repeated trial-and-error exploration is neither practical nor safe. An alternative line of work bypasses explicit simulation and learns probe guidance or autonomous scanning directly from tracked clinical scans and expert demonstrations ( Jiang et al., 2024b ; Jiang et al., 2024a ; Yue et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . While effective, this paradigm depends on collecting real image–action trajectories at scale and does not provide a reusable environment for evaluating counterfactual probe actions before they are executed on patients. These limitations motivate a controllable generative environment learned directly from clinical ultrasound videos, capable of synthesizing realistic future observations in response to probe actions without tracking each patient.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的机器人超声环境暴露出可控性、真实性和安全性之间的根本权衡。 物理模型和基于物理的模拟器允许对探头姿态进行受控探索，但其合成解剖结构和图像生成方式与临床超声存在显著领域差异（Shams et al., 2008；Bürger et al., 2013；Gao et al., 2009）。 对重建的三维超声体积进行重切片可提供更逼真的观察结果，但需要针对特定受试者进行追踪采集，且无法忠实地再现探头在任意方向下依赖视角的外观变化（Lasso et al., 2014）。 扫描真实患者可获得符合实际临床分布的观察数据，但反复的试错探索既不实用也不安全。 另一种研究路线则绕过了显式模拟，直接从追踪的临床扫描和专家演示中学习探头引导或自主扫描（Jiang et al., 2024b；Jiang et al., 2024a；Yue et al., 2025；Su et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2025）。 尽管这一方法有效，但它依赖于大规模收集真实的图像-动作轨迹，且无法提供一个可重复使用的环境，用于在执行前评估反事实的探头动作。 这些局限性促使我们构建一个可控的生成式环境，该环境直接从临床超声视频中学习，能够合成响应探头动作的逼真未来观察结果，而无需对每位患者进行追踪。

paragraphs.en: Controllable world models offer a promising data-driven alternative by learning to predict future observations conditioned on actions, and have emerged as powerful interactive simulators for games, autonomous driving, and robotic manipulation ( Hou et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026a ) . Ultrasound, however, presents a distinct challenge: each frame captures only a 2D cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, such that small probe motions, particularly out-of-plane translations and rotations, can induce large changes in image appearance. Consequently, a causal, pose-controllable world model that can generate realistic ultrasound observations directly from clinical data remains largely unexplored.

paragraphs.en: We introduce SonoWorld, a causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model that learns ultrasound video dynamics primarily from large-scale unlabeled clinical videos and requires only a small set of EM-tracked scans to acquire 6-DoF control. Inspired by previous works ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026a ) , SonoWorld is trained in three stages: First, we pretrain a latent-action video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames, allowing it to capture both probe-induced appearance changes and physiological dynamics without pose annotations. Second, we ground the learned dynamics to physical probe motion by post-training on a small set of calibrated EM-tracked thyroid scans, where probe motion is represented as relative 6-DoF actions in the probe coordinate frame. Finally, we distill the bidirectional model into a causal autoregressive generator using self-forcing and selectively retain informative KV-cache tokens, enabling stable long-horizon interactive rollouts. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

paragraphs.en: Generative world models learn action-conditioned dynamics of visual environments and have emerged as a scalable paradigm for interactive simulation across embodied AI ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Jang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026a ; Huang et al., 2026a ) , games ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Kanervisto et al., 2025 ) , autonomous driving ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . A central challenge in scaling such models is that action-labeled data are far less abundant than passive video. Latent-action models address this imbalance by discovering control-relevant dynamics directly from visual observations: Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) learns discrete latent actions, AdaWorld ( Gao et al., 2025 ) extends them to a continuous action space, and subsequent work like DreamDojo scales this paradigm to real-world robotic application ( Gao et al., 2026a ) and grounds learned latent actions into executable robot commands ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . This separation between learning visual dynamics from abundant unlabeled video and grounding them to physical actions provides a natural foundation for domains where paired action–video data are costly to acquire.

paragraphs.en: In the medical field generative world models have recently emerged as learned simulators for medical video. Endora ( Li et al., 2024 ) models spatiotemporal dynamics to generate realistic endoscopic videos, while Surgical Vision World Model ( Koju et al., 2025 ) learns latent actions from unlabeled surgical videos for controllable generation, and SAW ( Rapuri et al., 2026 ) further conditions laparoscopic video generation on language, tissue affordances, and 2D tool trajectories. In ultrasound, Cardiac Copilot ( Jiang et al., 2024b ) learns a latent spatial model from tracked echocardiography and predicts structural features of neighboring cardiac planes for probe guidance; Structure-aware World Model ( Jiang et al., 2024a ) extends this paradigm with large-scale self-supervised learning of anatomical representations under 3D pose transformations; and EchoWorld ( Yue et al., 2025 ) incorporates motion-induced visual dynamics and visual–motion history for sequential probe guidance, but these methods use world modeling primarily for representation learning rather than as image-generating interactive environments. More recently, Fan et al. ( Fan et al., 2026 ) predict future ultrasound observations conditioned on tracked probe motions and use the learned dynamics for goal-plane navigation. In contrast, SonoWorld learns ultrasound dynamics primarily from large-scale untracked clinical videos, grounds them to metric 6-DoF probe actions using a small tracked subset, and causally generates future observations under these actions, enabling interactive rollouts for policy evaluation and model-based action discrimination.

paragraphs.en: Several strategies exist for building an environment in which probe motion can be explored. Physical phantoms provide genuine acoustic interaction but lack clinical appearance and encode a single fixed anatomy. Physics-based simulation renders images from a CT-derived anatomical model at arbitrary poses ( Shams et al., 2008 ; Bürger et al., 2013 ; Salehi et al., 2015 ) , yet ray-casting cannot reproduce speckle from first principles ( Gao et al., 2009 ) and wave-accurate solvers are too slow to be interactive ( Jaros et al., 2016 ) . General-purpose robotics platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim support scalable robotic ultrasound simulation and policy training, but their simplified ultrasound image formation does not faithfully capture the acoustic properties of clinical ultrasound ( Gao et al., 2026b ) . Sim-to-real translation narrows the appearance gap ( Vitale et al., 2020 ) at the cost of physical consistency. Freehand reconstruction compounds a tracked sweep into a volume that can be re-sliced ( Lasso et al., 2014 ) , but view-dependent effects are frozen at the acquisition angle and every simulated subject needs its own tracked acquisition. Scanning real patients is the fidelity upper bound ( Su et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , yet a scan traverses a single trajectory and cannot report what a different motion would have produced. A learned world model addresses these limitations, inheriting real appearance, view-dependent acoustics and physiological motion from clinical video, covering anatomical variation across patients, and answering potential pose queries without per-subject tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 存在多种策略可用于构建一个能够探索探针运动的环境。 物理假体可提供真实的声学交互，但缺乏临床外观且仅编码单一固定解剖结构。 基于物理的模拟可从源自CT的解剖模型中渲染任意姿态下的图像（Shams et al., 2008；Bürger et al., 2013；Salehi et al., 2015），但射线投射法无法从第一原理重现散斑（Gao et al., 2009），而波精确求解器的速度过慢，难以实现交互（Jaros et al., 2016）。 NVIDIA Isaac Sim等通用机器人平台支持可扩展的机器人超声模拟与策略训练，但其简化的超声图像生成方式未能真实还原临床超声的声学特性（Gao et al., 2026b）。 从模拟到现实的迁移可缩小外观差异（Vitale et al., 2020），但会牺牲物理一致性。 自由手重建将追踪到的扫描轨迹合成一个可重新切片的体积（Lasso et al., 2014），但视角依赖效应会被锁定在采集角度，且每个模拟对象都需要独立的追踪采集数据。 对真实患者进行扫描是保真度的上限（Su et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2025），但单次扫描仅沿单一轨迹进行，无法反映不同运动方式可能产生的结果。 一种学习的世界模型能够克服这些局限性：它从临床视频中继承真实外观、视角依赖的声学特性及生理运动，涵盖患者间的解剖差异，并无需针对每个对象进行追踪即可回答潜在的姿态查询。

paragraphs.en: Ultrasound video dynamics arise from both probe motion, which changes the imaged anatomical cross-section, and physiological motion, such as cardiac contraction, respiration, and vascular pulsation. To capture these dynamics without action annotations, we learn a latent action model (LAM) inspired by AdaWorld ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . Given a clip 𝐱 1 : K \mathbf{x}^{1:K} , the encoder patchifies each adjacent frame pair ( 𝐱 i , 𝐱 i + 1 ) (\mathbf{x}^{i},\mathbf{x}^{i+1}) into 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches, appends a learnable action token to each frame, and processes them with alternating spatial and temporal attention. The action token of 𝐱 i + 1 \mathbf{x}^{i+1} is compressed into a 32 32 -dimensional latent action 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}^{i} , while the patch tokens are discarded. A decoder reconstructs 𝐱 i + 1 \mathbf{x}^{i+1} from 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}^{i} and 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}^{i} . This low-dimensional bottleneck encourages 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}^{i} to encode frame-to-frame dynamics rather than appearance shared across frames. Full architectural details are provided in Appendix Fig 5 .

paragraphs.en: The latent actions learned during pretraining capture transition dynamics but lack physical units and therefore cannot directly control probe motion. paragraphs.en: We introduce a chunk action , in which every frame carries its cumulative motion since the start of its own four-frame window, matching the temporal compression of the Wan VAE. Within each four-frame window, each frame is represented by its cumulative motion from the window start, and the four 6-DoF motions are concatenated into a 24 24 -dimensional action. Post-training is initialized from the pretrained model with the latent-action pathway replaced by a new metric-action pathway. Each chunk action is projected from ℝ 24 \mathbb{R}^{24} to the model dimension and added to the corresponding timestep embedding before adaptive layer normalization, with a zero action assigned to the initial latent frame. Generation is conditioned on the first clean latent frame, encoded as a prefix by concatenating the masked clean latents with a binary mask indicating observed frames and projecting them through a parallel convolution added to the backbone patch embedding. Both the action projection and prefix convolution are zero-initialized, preserving the pretrained function at initialization. The entire DiT generator is then trained end-to-end with all parameters unfrozen.

paragraphs.en: The post-trained model uses bidirectional attention over all latent frames and therefore denoises an entire clip jointly, precluding interactive generation. An interactive probe simulator requires that the next block of frames be emitted as soon as the operator supplies the next action. We therefore convert the model into an efficient block-causal, few-step generator that attends only backward in time and carries a KV cache across blocks. Direct autoregressive training, however, introduces exposure bias ( Bengio et al., 2015 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) : a model trained on ground-truth context must condition on its own predictions at inference, causing errors to accumulate over long rollouts. We therefore adopt self-forcing distillation ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , in which each block is generated from a KV cache constructed from the student’s own preceding outputs, reducing the mismatch between training and autoregressive inference. Long-horizon generation additionally requires controlling the growth of the KV cache. Existing streaming video generators bound memory by retaining an attention sink and a recent temporal window while discarding intermediate history ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . We instead treat the choice of which frames to retain as a selection problem. Inspired by heavy-hitter eviction in language models ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , we score each cached frame by the attention mass it has received and retain the highest-scoring frames alongside the sink and the recent window, applying rotary embeddings when keys are written into the cache so that retained frames keep their original positions. At inference, SonoWorld can generate ultrasound video at 40.6 fps at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution using four denoising steps on a single NVIDIA H100, enabling interactive action-conditioned rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 经过预训练的智能体在所有潜在帧上采用双向注意力机制，因此能够联合消除整个视频片段中的噪声，从而避免了交互式生成。 交互式探针模拟器要求操作者提供下一个动作后，系统必须立即输出下一组帧。 因此，我们将该智能体转换为一个高效的块因果、少步生成器，它仅向后关注时间序列，并在各块之间保留 KV 缓存。 然而，直接的自回归训练会引入暴露偏差（Bengio 等，2015；Chen 等，2024；Liu 等，2026）：在真实上下文中训练的模型在推理时必须以自身预测为条件，导致长时间生成过程中错误不断累积。 因此，我们采用了自强化蒸馏（Huang 等，2026b），其中每个块都由学生模型自身先前输出构建的 KV 缓存生成，从而减少了训练与自回归推理之间的不匹配。 长时程生成还需要控制 KV 缓存的增长。 现有的流式视频生成器通过保留注意力汇点和一个近期的时间窗口，同时丢弃中间历史来限制内存使用（Liu 等，2026；Lu 等，2026）。 我们则将其转化为一个选择问题：决定保留哪些帧。 受语言模型中“重 hitter 驱逐”机制的启发（Zhang 等，2023），我们通过每个缓存帧所获得的注意力权重为其打分，并保留得分最高的帧，同时保留汇点和近期窗口；在将键写入缓存时应用旋转嵌入，以确保保留的帧保持其原始位置。 在推理阶段，SonoWorld 可在单台 NVIDIA H100 上通过四步去噪，以 256×256 分辨率生成 40.6 fps 的超声视频，从而实现交互式动作条件生成。

paragraphs.en: Under IRB approval, we collect a large-scale corpus of freehand ultrasound videos acquired during routine clinical examinations, without any probe-pose annotation. The raw corpus consists of 64,599 video files spanning three anatomical regions: abdomen (31,209 files, 48.3%), thyroid (21,399 files, 33.1%), and cardiac (11,991 files, 18.6%), totaling 15,357,337 frames. Because clinical recordings are noisy, we design an automated filtering pipeline that removes colour Doppler acquisitions, discards static segments, and excludes segments without probe–skin contact. Retained segments are cropped to the imaging field of view, temporally resampled to 16 fps, resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , and divided into non-overlapping 3-second chunks of 45 frames each; segments shorter than 3 seconds are discarded. This yields 153,892 training clips: abdomen (106,990), cardiac (26,095), and thyroid (20,807), totaling 6,925,140 frames. These clips are used to train the latent-action video model and the foundational video diffusion model. For validation, we hold out 500 clips: 64 thyroid clips together with 218 liver and 218 cardiac clips.

paragraphs.en: To condition the model on the probe motion, we collect thyroid ultrasound scans with synchronized 6-DoF pose measurements using a dual-sensor electromagnetic (EM) tracking system. One sensor is mounted on the probe handle and the second on the patient, allowing probe motion to be expressed relative to the subject rather than the field generator. Each scan follows a fixed acquisition protocol covering three translational and three rotational degrees of freedom. While actions are represented in full 6-DoF, surface-normal translation is physically constrained by probe–skin contact and tissue compression, so freehand scanning effectively explores a contact-constrained subset of the 6-DoF pose space. The dataset contains EM-tracked scans from 42 distinct subjects, split at the subject level into 33 for training and 9 for validation, with no subject overlap. Videos are cropped to the ultrasound field of view, resampled to 16 fps, and resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 . Each scan is cut into non-overlapping 45-frame windows, and every rollout is conditioned on the first latent frame of its window plus a 6-DoF action sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了用探针运动对模型进行条件训练，我们使用双传感器电磁（EM）跟踪系统收集了同步记录 6-DoF 姿态信息的甲状腺超声扫描数据。 其中一个传感器安装在探针手柄上，另一个则安装在患者身上，这样探针的运动就可以相对于受试者而非场发生器来描述。 每次扫描都遵循固定的采集协议，涵盖三个平移自由度和三个旋转自由度。 虽然动作以完整的 6-DoF 表示，但表面法线方向的平移受到探针与皮肤接触及组织压缩的物理限制，因此自由手扫描实际上是在 6-DoF 姿态空间中探索一个受接触约束的子集。 该数据集包含来自 42 名不同受试者的经电磁跟踪的扫描数据，按受试者层级划分为 33 例用于训练和 9 例用于验证，且各受试者之间无重叠。 视频被裁剪至超声视野范围，重采样为 16 fps，并调整大小至 256 × 256 256\times 256。 每次扫描都被分割为互不重叠的 45 帧窗口，每个展开过程都以该窗口的第一个潜在帧以及一个 6-DoF 动作序列作为条件输入。

sents.zh: 每次扫描都遵循固定的采集协议，涵盖三个平移自由度和三个旋转自由度。

sents.en: While actions are represented in full 6-DoF, surface-normal translation is physically constrained by probe–skin contact and tissue compression, so freehand scanning effectively explores a contact-constrained subset of the 6-DoF pose space.
sents.zh: 虽然动作以完整的 6-DoF 表示，但表面法线方向的平移受到探针与皮肤接触及组织压缩的物理限制，因此自由手扫描实际上是在 6-DoF 姿态空间中探索一个受接触约束的子集。

sents.en: The dataset contains EM-tracked scans from 42 distinct subjects, split at the subject level into 33 for training and 9 for validation, with no subject overlap.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含来自 42 名不同受试者的经电磁跟踪的扫描数据，按受试者层级划分为 33 例用于训练和 9 例用于验证，且各受试者之间无重叠。

sents.en: Videos are cropped to the ultrasound field of view, resampled to 16 fps, and resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 .

sents.en: Each scan is cut into non-overlapping 45-frame windows, and every rollout is conditioned on the first latent frame of its window plus a 6-DoF action sequence.
sents.zh: 每次扫描都被分割为互不重叠的 45 帧窗口，每个展开过程都以该窗口的第一个潜在帧以及一个 6-DoF 动作序列作为条件输入。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether SonoWorld responds to commanded probe motion rather than merely extrapolating plausible video dynamics, we evaluate it under four complementary action settings. Original pose replays the measured probe trajectory and measures in-distribution action-following fidelity. Zero motion feeds an all-zero action sequence, so the rollout should stay on the initial frame with only physiological motion. Speed × 2 \times 2 subsamples the trajectory by a factor of two, approximately doubling the displacement per step and testing whether the model responds to the commanded motion magnitude rather than a characteristic training-time velocity. Round trip follows the measured forward trajectory and then appends the exact inverse motion in reverse temporal order. This setting tests whether pose-conditioned generation remains stable over an extended trajectory that returns to the initial probe pose. For each setting, we quantify generation fidelity using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against original sequence, reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over evaluation clips.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 SonoWorld 是否对指令探针对应动作做出响应，而不仅仅是外推合理的视频动态，我们在四种互补的动作设置下对其进行了评估。 原始姿态重播会重现测量得到的探针轨迹，并衡量分布内动作跟随的保真度。 零运动输入一个全零的动作序列，因此展开过程应保持在初始帧上，仅包含生理性运动。 速度 × 2 \times 2 以二倍因子对轨迹进行子采样，大致使每步位移加倍，并测试模型是否对指令的运动幅度做出响应，而非训练时的特征速度。 往返行程遵循测量得到的正向轨迹，然后以相反的时间顺序附加精确的逆运动。 该设置用于测试姿态条件生成在返回初始探针姿态的延长轨迹上是否保持稳定。 对于每种设置，我们使用 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 对生成结果与原始序列的保真度进行量化，并以均值 ± \pm 标准差的形式报告评估片段上的结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 evaluates whether SonoWorld follows the commanded probe trajectory rather than merely producing plausible ultrasound dynamics. Under Original pose , the generated sequence is compared with the observations acquired along the measured trajectory; thus, PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS quantify how accurately the model reproduces the image evolution induced by real probe motion. The causal model remains close to the bidirectional teacher, with only a 0.75 dB decrease in PSNR, a 0.016 decrease in SSIM, and a 0.026 increase in LPIPS, indicating that causal generation largely preserves pose-conditioned fidelity while enabling streaming inference with four denoising steps. Zero motion directly probes null-action stability: setting all 6-DoF actions to zero suppresses probe-induced evolution and all generated observations are substantially near the initial imaging plane, indicating that the generated dynamics respond to the supplied probe actions rather than following an autonomous motion prior. Speed × 2 \times 2 increases the probe displacement per generation step while preserving the underlying trajectory. Both models maintain nearly unchanged reconstruction quality, showing that the predicted image evolution scales with the commanded motion magnitude rather than a fixed temporal or motion prior. Round trip further tests whether the learned action representation is approximately reversible: after following the forward trajectory, the model is driven by the reversed actions in negated order. This is the most challenging setting, with PSNR decreasing by 0.43 dB for the bidirectional model and 0.92 dB for the causal model. The larger degradation of the causal model is consistent with error accumulation over the longer autoregressive rollout (23 versus 12 latent frames), while its retained fidelity indicates that learned control remains effective over extended bidirectional motion. We further evaluate axis-specific controllability using synthetic actions that vary one degree of freedom while holding the others fixed in Appendix Fig. 9 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether latent actions provide a effective conditioning signal for learning ultrasound dynamics from the large multi-organ corpus, where probe poses are unavailable. We compare two models with the same Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone and training recipe, differing only in whether the learned 32-dimensional latent action is injected through adaptive layer normalization during training and inference. Evaluation is performed on an organ-balanced held-out set of 500 clips, where each rollout is conditioned on the first three latent frames and generates the remaining nine. As shown in Table 2 , latent-action conditioning improves PSNR by 3.60 3.60 dB and SSIM by 0.083 0.083 , while reducing LPIPS by 0.067 0.067 . The substantial and consistent improvements across all three metrics demonstrate the effectiveness of latent-action conditioning in learning ultrasound video dynamics, showing that the learned latent actions capture transition-relevant information that substantially reduces the ambiguity of future observations from visual context alone.

paragraphs.en: A practical interactive world model must generate observations causally as probe actions arrive, while remaining stable over autoregressive rollouts. Converting the bidirectional model to causal generation therefore introduces a central training challenge: errors in generated context can accumulate over time, and the choice of causal training strategy directly determines long-horizon rollout quality. We compare several causal training strategies under a controlled setting. All causal variants are initialized from the same post-trained bidirectional model, trained on the same 33 EM-tracked scans, and differ only in how the causal context is constructed during training. We evaluate 8-second rollouts (129 image frames; 33 latent frames) conditioned on an initial frame and the measured 6-DoF probe trajectory, with the bidirectional model included as a non-causal reference. As shown in Table 3 , self-forcing ( Huang et al., 2026b ) achieves the best perceptual quality among causal variants, with SSIM 0.394 0.394 and LPIPS 0.436 0.436 , while remaining within 0.15 0.15 dB PSNR of the bidirectional reference. Teacher forcing yields slightly higher PSNR ( 16.44 16.44 dB) but substantially worse LPIPS ( 0.515 0.515 ), while diffusion, rolling, and reward forcing degrade more consistently across metrics. These results indicate that exposing the model to its own generated context during training better matches the autoregressive inference distribution and preserves visual fidelity over long causal rollouts.

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon causal generation requires efficient management of temporal context. Retaining the full KV cache preserves all history but causes memory and attention cost to grow with rollout length, limiting scalable interactive inference. We therefore study whether a bounded cache can retain the information necessary for generation while reducing this cost. We apply different latent-frame-level KV-cache policies at inference time to the same self-forcing model, with no retraining, and evaluate 8-second rollouts containing 33 latent frames. Full KV retains all 33 frames (self-forcing default setting); Local keeps only the 12 most recent; Sink+Local retains 3 initial frames together with the 12 most recent ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) ; and Eviction+Local keeps 8 intermediate frames and the 4 most recent, where intermediate frames are selected either uniformly or by accumulated attention mass ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . As shown in Table 4 , all bounded-cache variants remain within 0.14 0.14 dB PSNR, 0.007 0.007 SSIM, and 0.004 0.004 LPIPS of full attention, despite retaining as few as 12 of 33 frames. SonoWorld with selective eviction achieves the best PSNR ( 16.37 16.37 ) and SSIM ( 0.394 0.394 ), while matching the best LPIPS ( 0.436 0.436 ). paragraphs.en: A practical ultrasound world model should provide plausible and anatomically consistent feedback under interactive probe control, enabling applications such as robotic policy evaluation, operator training, and exploration of probe–anatomy relationships. Because counterfactual probe trajectories often lack paired ground-truth videos, pixel-level reconstruction metrics alone are insufficient to assess such rollouts. We therefore conduct a user study with five experienced ultrasound raters on 55 generated clips, evaluating three complementary criteria: image quality , video consistency , and probe–anatomy alignment . We evaluate two settings. First, the initial frame is fixed while the probe follows three distinct trajectories (Path A–C), testing whether different actions induce coherent, path-dependent observations. Second, the probe trajectory is fixed while the conditioning frame is shifted laterally from the thyroid midline, with negative δ ​ x \delta x corresponding to the left lobe and positive δ ​ x \delta x to the right lobe. As shown in Table 5 , probe–anatomy alignment consistently receives the highest scores, followed by video consistency, while image quality receives relatively lower scores. These results indicate that SonoWorld maintains anatomically aligned and temporally consistent ultrasound observations across different probe trajectories and initial views, even when image fidelity is imperfect, which further confirms SonoWorld can closely follow the probe action.

paragraphs.en: SonoWorld can support robotic navigation only if its predicted futures are sufficiently action-sensitive. We therefore evaluate the world model as an action-scoring mechanism for goal-directed navigation. Given an initial ultrasound frame and a target frame from a held-out tracked scan, we construct two equal-magnitude candidate trajectories along a single degree of freedom: one toward the target pose and one in the opposite direction. SonoWorld generates the terminal observation for each candidate, and PSNR to the target frame serves as the reward. A trial is successful when the action toward the true target receives the higher reward. paragraphs.en: We present SonoWorld, a causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model that generates future observations conditioned on metric 6-DoF probe motion. SonoWorld learns ultrasound dynamics from around 6.9 million unlabeled clinical ultrasound video frames, grounds them to physical probe actions using a small set of EM-tracked freehand scans, and is distilled into an autoregressive generator with bounded KV-cache inference. Although action grounding is evaluated on thyroid ultrasound, the SonoWorld framework is not organ-specific and can, in principle, be extended to other anatomical regions, such as abdominal organs, given appropriate tracked data for action grounding. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of SonoWorld as a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound acquisition and policy evaluation. It is worth noticing probe pose also does not fully determine ultrasound appearance: tissue deformation, physiological motion remain unobserved factors, indicating the limitation of this work. The absence of a shared public benchmark also prevents a direct quantitative comparison with the closest action-conditioned ultrasound world model, motivating standardized tracked-ultrasound benchmarks in future work.

paragraphs.en: The latent action model (LAM) ( Gao et al., 2025 ) is a conditional variational autoencoder that infers a compact code for the transition between two frames (Fig. 5 ). Given a source frame x i x^{i} and a target frame x i + 1 x^{i+1} , each frame is split into non-overlapping patches, giving patch-token sequences u i u^{i} and u i + 1 u^{i+1} . A learnable action token, z i z^{i} or z i + 1 z^{i+1} , is prepended to each sequence. The encoder E ϕ E_{\phi} is a spatio-temporal transformer whose blocks alternate spatial attention within each frame with temporal attention across the two frames. Through temporal attention, the action token of the target frame gathers information from the source frame. We keep only this token and discard all patch tokens. A linear head maps this token to the mean μ \mu and variance σ 2 \sigma^{2} of a diagonal Gaussian posterior q ϕ ​ ( z i + 1 ∣ x i , x i + 1 ) q_{\phi}(z^{i+1}\mid x^{i},x^{i+1}) , which yields a low-dimensional latent action z i + 1 z^{i+1} . The decoder D ψ D_{\psi} is a spatial-only transformer. It predicts the target frame x ^ i + 1 \hat{x}^{i+1} from the source tokens u i u^{i} , with z i + 1 z^{i+1} added to every token. Because the decoder never sees x i + 1 x^{i+1} , the target frame can reach its own reconstruction only through z i + 1 z^{i+1} . The source frame already provides the appearance, so this bottleneck forces z i + 1 z^{i+1} to encode the change between the two frames (probe motion and the resulting anatomical displacement) rather than the anatomy itself.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在动作模型（LAM）（Gao 等人，2025）是一种条件变分自编码器，用于推断两帧之间转换的紧凑编码（图 5）。 给定源帧 x^{i} 和目标帧 x^{i+1}，每帧被分割为不重叠的块，得到块-令牌序列 u^{i} 和 u^{i+1}。 一个可学习的动作令牌 z^{i} 或 z^{i+1} 被添加到每个序列的开头。 编码器 E_{\phi} 是一种时空变换器，其各模块在每帧内的空间注意力和两帧之间的时间注意力之间交替进行。 通过时间注意力，目标帧的动作令牌会收集来自源帧的信息。 我们仅保留该令牌，并丢弃所有块令牌。 一个线性头将该令牌映射到对角高斯后验 q_{\phi}(z^{i+1}\mid x^{i},x^{i+1}) 的均值 μ 和方差 σ^{2}，从而得到低维潜在动作 z^{i+1}。 解码器 D_{\psi} 是一种仅包含空间注意力的变换器。 它根据源令牌 u^{i} 预测目标帧 \hat{x}^{i+1}，同时将 z^{i+1} 添加到每个令牌中。 由于解码器从未看到 x^{i+1}，因此目标帧只能通过 z^{i+1} 实现自身的重建。 源帧已经提供了外观信息，因此这个瓶颈迫使 z^{i+1} 编码两帧之间的变化（探测运动及其导致的解剖学位移），而非解剖学结构本身。

paragraphs.en: The foundational model is trained on the full 153,892-clip multi-organ corpus, composed of 69.5 % 69.5\% abdomen, 17.0 % 17.0\% cardiac and 13.5 % 13.5\% thyroid clips. Training reads cached latents and cached actions rather than pixels: each clip is stored as a 12 × 16 × 32 × 32 12\times 16\times 32\times 32 latent, the Wan VAE encoding of 45 frames at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , together with its 12 × 32 12\times 32 sequence of latent actions, and a per-organ T5 text embedding cached once and looked up by organ label. The VAE, the text encoder and the latent action model are therefore absent from the training loop, which is what makes a 768-clip effective batch affordable. No data augmentation is applied at this stage: at this corpus size the data supplies its own diversity, and caching is the more valuable trade.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型是在完整的 153,892 个剪辑的多器官语料库上训练的，该语料库由 69.5% 的腹部剪辑、17.0% 的心脏剪辑和 13.5% 的甲状腺剪辑组成。 训练过程读取的是缓存的潜在表示和缓存的动作，而非像素：每个剪辑都以 12 × 16 × 32 × 32 的潜在表示存储，即 Wan VAE 对 45 帧 256 × 256 图像的编码结果，同时还包括其 12 × 32 的潜在动作序列，以及按器官标签缓存并查找的每个器官的 T5 文本嵌入。 因此，VAE、文本编码器和潜在动作模型均未参与训练循环，这使得 768 个剪辑的有效批量训练成为可能。 此阶段未应用任何数据增强：在该语料库规模下，数据本身已具备足够的多样性，而缓存是更具价值的权衡选择。

paragraphs.en: The EM-tracked corpus is three orders of magnitude smaller, 42 tracked thyroid scans yielding 262 clips, which is too few to learn a controllable mapping from a 24-dimensional action to nine generated latent frames. We therefore invert the trade made above and do not train on precomputed clips at all. The dataloader reads whole segments, samples a 45-frame window inside the probe-contact interval, applies one temporal augmentation, and VAE-encodes the result on the fly. Every augmentation is expressed as a length-45 integer index array into the source frames; the same index is applied to the pixel frames and to the per-frame tip pose, and the action is recomputed from the indexed pose by the procedure of Section A.2 . No per-augmentation action algebra is needed, and the action is correct by construction for any index map. Table 8 lists the four cases, sampled with equal probability.
paragraphs.zh: 经 EM 跟踪的语料库规模小三个数量级：42 个经过跟踪的甲状腺扫描生成了 262 个片段，这一数量太少，无法从 24 维动作到九个生成的潜在帧中学到可控的映射关系。 因此，我们逆转了上述权衡，完全不使用预计算的片段进行训练。 数据加载器读取整个片段，在探针接触区间内采样一个包含 45 帧的窗口，应用一次时间增广，并实时对结果进行 VAE 编码。 每次增广都表示为一个长度为 45 的整数索引数组，用于指向源帧；相同的索引也应用于像素帧和每帧的探针姿态，而动作则通过 A.2 节的程序从经索引化的姿态重新计算得出。 无需针对每次增广执行动作代数运算，且对于任何索引映射，该动作都能保证正确性。 表 8 列出了这四种情况，它们以相等的概率被采样。

paragraphs.en: Stop-motion freezes a fraction ρ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.1 , 0.35 ) \rho\sim\mathcal{U}(0.1,0.35) of the 45 output steps by repeating the current frame, which yields action entries that are exactly zero. This is the only mechanism that places a null action inside the training distribution, and it is what teaches the model the correspondence between a zero action and a static image. Stride augmentation requires a longer source window, 133 frames at σ = 3 \sigma=3 , which is why segments rather than pre-cut clips are the unit of storage. Because windows and augmentations are resampled online, a pass over the 262 slots does not repeat data: the effective sample space is the set of draws of window start, augmentation and noise.

paragraphs.en: Pretraining follows a four-stage curriculum in which each stage warm-starts the next and every stage trains the full network. A per-frame stage on single latent frames teaches speckle statistics and anatomy without any temporal burden, at an effective batch of 1536 frames; a video stage extends to whole 12-frame clips; a prefix stage adds the three-frame conditioning branch; and the final stage adds the latent-action branch. The last three stages all use an effective batch of 768 clips, so one epoch over the corpus is 201 optimizer steps. Post-training warm-starts from the final stage with the latent-action head removed. Table 9 lists the settings of both stages; they differ only in batch size and step count, which follow from the corpus sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练遵循一个四阶段课程，其中每个阶段都为下一阶段提供暖启动，并且每个阶段都训练整个网络。 针对单个潜在帧的每帧阶段可教授斑点统计和解剖结构，且没有任何时间负担，有效批处理量为 1536 帧；视频阶段则扩展到完整的 12 帧片段；前缀阶段增加了三帧条件分支；最后阶段则增加了潜在动作分支。 后三个阶段均使用 768 个片段的有效批处理量，因此对语料库进行一次完整遍历需要 201 个优化器步数。 后训练阶段从最后阶段开始暖启动，但移除了潜在动作头。 表 9 列出了两个阶段的设置；它们仅在批处理大小和步数上有所不同，这些差异源于语料库的大小。

paragraphs.en: All four autoencoders reconstruct ultrasound video accurately, spanning 36.24 36.24 to 36.62 36.62 dB PSNR and 0.900 0.900 to 0.922 0.922 SSIM, a spread of 0.38 0.38 dB and 0.022 0.022 respectively. Autoencoders trained on natural video therefore transfer to ultrasound without retraining, despite speckle texture and view-dependent acoustic artefacts having no counterpart in natural video. Reconstruction quality does not discriminate between the four, and they separate on cost instead. HunyuanVideo-1.5 requires 18.85 18.85 GB of peak memory against 2.22 2.22 GB for Wan2.1 and runs at half the throughput, while giving the worst LPIPS by a factor of 1.9 1.9 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有四种自编码器都能准确重建超声视频，其 PSNR 范围从 36.24 到 36.62 dB，SSIM 范围从 0.900 到 0.922，分别有 0.38 dB 和 0.022 的跨度。因此，在自然视频上训练的自编码器无需重新训练即可迁移到超声视频领域，尽管散斑纹理和视角相关的声学伪影在自然视频中并无对应物。四种自编码器的重建质量没有明显差异，但它们在成本上却有所不同。HunyuanVideo-1.5 需要 18.85 GB 的峰值内存，而 Wan2.1 仅需 2.22 GB；HunyuanVideo-1.5 的运行吞吐量仅为后者的一半，同时其 LPIPS 得分最差，差距达到 1.9 倍。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 visualizes latent action model predictions on thyroid, cardiac and abdominal scans. The encoder infers a 32-dimensional latent action from a frame pair, and the decoder reconstructs the next frame from the current frame and that action alone, never seeing the next frame itself, so any predicted change must have passed through the bottleneck. The predicted frames recover the anatomy and its displacement but are smoother than the ground truth, since speckle decorrelates between frames and is not predictable from a 32-dimensional code. The two difference maps highlight the same regions in all three organs, indicating that the latent action captures transition-relevant information beyond the appearance already provided by the source frame.
paragraphs.zh: 图6展示了潜在动作模型在甲状腺、心脏和腹部扫描图像上的预测结果。 编码器从一对帧中推断出32维的潜在动作，而解码器仅根据当前帧和该动作重建下一帧，从未直接看到下一帧本身，因此任何预测的变化都必须经过瓶颈层。 预测的帧恢复了解剖结构和其位移，但比真实图像更平滑，因为斑点噪声在不同帧之间会去相关，且无法从32维编码中预测出来。 两张差异图在所有三个器官中都突出了相同的区域，表明潜在动作捕捉到了超越源帧所提供外观信息的、与过渡相关的信息。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 reports 8-second generation across the three organs. Latent actions improve every metric on every organ, by 4.74 4.74 dB PSNR, 0.114 0.114 SSIM and 0.121 0.121 LPIPS on average. The gain is largest on abdominal scans ( + 6.42 +6.42 dB) and smallest on thyroid ( + 3.21 +3.21 dB), while the ordering of absolute difficulty is unchanged: thyroid remains the hardest organ in both settings, reflecting its fine-scale structure and its small share of the corpus. The resulting performance gap quantifies the predictive value of latent transition information beyond visual context alone. paragraphs.en: Table 12 examines whether latent-action pretraining benefits downstream pose control. We compare two causal models with identical post-training and distillation, differing only in whether latent actions were used during pretraining, and evaluate both under five probe trajectories. Latent-action pretraining improves every metric under every trajectory: PSNR increases by 0.40 dB for the original pose, 0.42 dB for Speed × \times 2, 0.46 dB for the round trip and 0.42 dB for 8-second rollouts, with corresponding SSIM gains of 0.011–0.013 and LPIPS reductions of 0.005–0.008. The gain is smallest under zero motion (0.21 dB PSNR, 0.004 LPIPS), where the image remains largely static and generation relies mainly on the conditioning frame. The benefit of pretraining therefore grows when the probe moves, indicating that the dynamics learned from unlabeled videos chiefly help the model render motion-induced appearance changes rather than static anatomy. The round trip remains the most challenging setting for both models, yet the pretrained model retains a 0.46 dB advantage, the largest among all trajectories, suggesting that pretraining also reduces error accumulation over extended bidirectional motion. Finally, the advantage persists in 8-second rollouts that extend well beyond the 3-second training horizon, showing that the improvement from pretraining is not limited to short clips.
paragraphs.zh: 表 12 检验了潜在动作预训练是否对下游姿态控制有益。 我们比较了两个因果模型，它们在训练后处理和蒸馏阶段完全相同，唯一区别在于预训练期间是否使用了潜在动作，并在五种探测轨迹下对两者进行了评估。 潜在动作预训练在所有轨迹下的各项指标均有提升：原始姿态的 PSNR 提升了 0.40 dB，Speed × \times 2 提升了 0.42 dB，往返轨迹提升了 0.46 dB，8 秒滚动预测提升了 0.42 dB；对应的 SSIM 增益为 0.011–0.013，LPIPS 下降幅度为 0.005–0.008。 在零运动场景下（PSNR 提升 0.21 dB，LPIPS 下降 0.004），增益最小，此时图像基本保持静态，生成过程主要依赖条件帧。 因此，当探测对象移动时，预训练带来的益处会增强，这表明从无标签视频中学习到的动态特征主要帮助模型呈现由运动引起的外观变化，而非静态解剖结构。 往返轨迹对两个模型而言仍然是最具挑战性的场景，但预训练模型仍保持 0.46 dB 的优势，这是所有轨迹中最大的提升，表明预训练还能减少长时间双向运动中的误差累积。 最后，在远超 3 秒训练时间范围的 8 秒滚动预测中，这种优势依然存在，说明预训练带来的改进并不局限于短片段。

sents.en: Latent-action pretraining improves every metric under every trajectory: PSNR increases by 0.40 dB for the original pose, 0.42 dB for Speed × \times 2, 0.46 dB for the round trip and 0.42 dB for 8-second rollouts, with corresponding SSIM gains of 0.011–0.013 and LPIPS reductions of 0.005–0.008.
sents.zh: 潜在动作预训练在所有轨迹下的各项指标均有提升：原始姿态的 PSNR 提升了 0.40 dB，Speed × \times 2 提升了 0.42 dB，往返轨迹提升了 0.46 dB，8 秒滚动预测提升了 0.42 dB；对应的 SSIM 增益为 0.011–0.013，LPIPS 下降幅度为 0.005–0.008。

sents.en: The gain is smallest under zero motion (0.21 dB PSNR, 0.004 LPIPS), where the image remains largely static and generation relies mainly on the conditioning frame.
sents.zh: 在零运动场景下（PSNR 提升 0.21 dB，LPIPS 下降 0.004），增益最小，此时图像基本保持静态，生成过程主要依赖条件帧。

sents.en: The benefit of pretraining therefore grows when the probe moves, indicating that the dynamics learned from unlabeled videos chiefly help the model render motion-induced appearance changes rather than static anatomy.
sents.zh: 因此，当探测对象移动时，预训练带来的益处会增强，这表明从无标签视频中学习到的动态特征主要帮助模型呈现由运动引起的外观变化，而非静态解剖结构。

sents.en: The round trip remains the most challenging setting for both models, yet the pretrained model retains a 0.46 dB advantage, the largest among all trajectories, suggesting that pretraining also reduces error accumulation over extended bidirectional motion.
sents.zh: 往返轨迹对两个模型而言仍然是最具挑战性的场景，但预训练模型仍保持 0.46 dB 的优势，这是所有轨迹中最大的提升，表明预训练还能减少长时间双向运动中的误差累积。

sents.en: Finally, the advantage persists in 8-second rollouts that extend well beyond the 3-second training horizon, showing that the improvement from pretraining is not limited to short clips.
sents.zh: 最后，在远超 3 秒训练时间范围的 8 秒滚动预测中，这种优势依然存在，说明预训练带来的改进并不局限于短片段。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows 8-second rollouts on three held-out scans. The causal student is trained on 3-second clips of 12 latent frames, yet at inference it extends to 33 latent frames without retraining: the generation still follows the ground-truth anatomy at t = 8 t=8 s, well beyond its training horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了在三个预留扫描数据上进行的 8 秒推理过程。 因果学生在训练时使用的是包含 12 个潜在帧的 3 秒片段，但在推理阶段，它无需重新训练即可扩展至 33 个潜在帧：在 t = 8 t=8 s 时，生成结果仍然遵循真实解剖结构，这一时间点远超其训练范围。

sents.en: Figure 8 shows 8-second rollouts on three held-out scans.
sents.zh: 图 8 展示了在三个预留扫描数据上进行的 8 秒推理过程。

sents.en: The causal student is trained on 3-second clips of 12 latent frames, yet at inference it extends to 33 latent frames without retraining: the generation still follows the ground-truth anatomy at t = 8 t=8 s, well beyond its training horizon.
sents.zh: 因果学生在训练时使用的是包含 12 个潜在帧的 3 秒片段，但在推理阶段，它无需重新训练即可扩展至 33 个潜在帧：在 t = 8 t=8 s 时，生成结果仍然遵循真实解剖结构，这一时间点远超其训练范围。

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 shows the rating interface. The left panel renders the segmented thyroid in 3D together with the probe path, the probe frame and the current imaging plane, so that raters can see where each generated frame is taken from, with a whole-gland template inset for reference. The right panel plays the generated clip with its thyroid segmentation overlaid. Raters scrub the timeline and score image quality, video consistency and probe–anatomy alignment on 5-point scales.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10 展示了评分界面。 左侧面板以 3D 形式呈现分割后的甲状腺，同时显示探针路径、探针坐标系和当前成像平面，使评分者能够看到每个生成帧的采集位置，并配有整个腺体的模板作为参考。 右侧面板播放生成的视频片段，并叠加显示其甲状腺分割结果。 评分者可通过时间轴逐帧查看，并使用 5 分制对图像质量、视频连贯性以及探针与解剖结构的对齐程度进行评分。
